chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abu Baseer, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them).
Regarding the people of Lut (peace be upon him): 'You are committing an indecency, which no one in the worlds has done before you.'

So he (peace be upon him) said: 'Iblees came to them in a beautiful form, in which there was femininity, upon him were beautiful clothes. So he came to the youths from them and instructed them that they should fall upon him. Had he sought to them that he should fall upon them, they would have refused to him, but he sought to them that they should fall upon him. So when they did it, they attained pleasure. Then he went away from them and left them, so they fell upon each other.'

key_terms.الْفَاحِشَةَ: The indecency (specifically sodomy in this context)

ai.seo_question: How did Iblees trick the people of Lut into committing sodomy according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi elucidates the psychological mechanism behind the people of Lut's sin, attributing the initial act to Iblees appearing in a feminine guise to trick young men, which then cascaded into mutual indulgence. This highlights the Shia scholarly view of the transition from a singular, deceptive act to a widespread societal deviation, emphasizing the role of Satan in corrupting human nature. The story serves as a foundational example of how a unique sin can become normalized through internal contagion and mutual reinforcement.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Aban Bin Usman, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>)
regarding the people of Lutas [7:80] You are commiting an indecency, which no one in the worlds has done before you?

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Iblees<sup>la</sup> came to them in an image of beauty wherein was femininity, upon him<sup>la</sup> were beautiful clothes. So he<sup>la</sup> came over to the youths from them and instructed them that they should fall upon him<sup>la</sup>. Had he<sup>la</sup> sought to them that he<sup>la</sup> should fall upon them, they would have refused to him<sup>la</sup>, but he<sup>la</sup> sought to them that they should shall upon him<sup>la</sup>. So when they did it, they attained pleasure. Then he<sup>la</sup> went away from them and left them, so they fell upon each other’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr from Aban bin ‘Uthman from abu Basir who has said the following: “One of the two Imam, (abu Ja’far or abu ‘Abd Allah), ‘Alayhim al-Salam, has said, ‘In the case of the people of Lot mentioned in the Quran: “You engage in such indecent acts in which no one of the people of the world before had ever engaged,”’

He (the Imam) said, ‘Iblis (Satan) came to them in the form of a good looking person with femininity, with good looking clothes and he came to their young ones and asked them to have sex in his anus. Had he asked them to allow him have sex in their anus they would refuse but he did the opposite and when they did as he wanted them to do they enjoyed it. He went away and left them to engage in such indecent act with each other.’”
